notes.title: 2021-07-06 Difficulty System Update
notes.notes:
Difficulty System
The difficulty system is divided into four levels: Simple, Hard, Crazy, and Nightmare.
For maps of different levels, the probability of the appearance of elite monsters and enhanced monsters will be different.

Elite Monster
Elite monsters increase their health by 300%, increase their damage by 75%, and have one of the following four auras:


Life Aura: HP increased by 100%
Damage Aura: Increases damage caused by 20%
Move Speed Aura: Move Speed increased by 50%
Damage Reduction Aura: Damage taken is reduced by 20%

Enhanced Monster
Enhanced monsters will choose an additional effect from the followings:


Death Explosion: After death, it will cause 10/15/20/25/30 damage to enemy units in the area.
Death Aid: After death, restore 10/15/20/25/30 HP to friendly units in the area.
Death Shot: Fire bullets with damage of 10/15/20/25/30 in eight directions after death.
Injury Resistance: Resist the first two injuries
Unable to Smash: The damage received will not exceed 25% of the maximum HP.


Bug Fixed

POISON(2): Abnormal duration fixed.
POISON(4): Abnormal extra properties fixed.
Cross: Abnormal extra ATK fixed.

notes.title: 2021-05-01 Room Mechanism and Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Room Mechanism
In the new version, 7 traps/triggers have been added to the room, and use the new room mechanism to redo the maps of all areas.

Spike Trap
Any unit will activate the trap after stepping on it, and the trap will cause damage to all units above it after 1 second. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/ff2bb028ced95888aabd7de92074aef91e522387.gif

Arrow Trap
After any unit steps on the trigger, it will shoot an arrow from the corresponding launcher, causing damage to the first unit it touches. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/d676e8ef1afabc94f9113b1bb6240fed22cd9bf0.gif

Bomb Trap
After any unit steps on the trigger, it will shoot a bomb from the corresponding launcher with a random speed, and after a delay of 2 seconds, it will cause explosion damage to all units in a small area. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/a0b8b7eaf20dd560d6c0590848bebf7366c075d3.gif

Flame Trigger
The launcher will continue to spray flames, causing damage to any unit it touches. After the player steps on the trigger, the launcher will stop spraying flames. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/69ab393fce7898573578f102445e23a3ef17ee97.gif

Dancing Trigger
After the player steps on the trigger, the movement speed of all existing units in the room is increased by 100, which can be superimposed. The effect of a single trigger lasts for 15 seconds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/c5c0994ec1ae2f6dd9fd19bc3a756a088c12dc0d.gif

Obstacle Trigger
After the player steps on the trigger, some obstacles will change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/f12fdd37e3112acff5b7853d11256a2bf6ff78ce.gif

Pass Trigger
After the player steps on the trigger, he/she passes through the current room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/70f8a3dc83ac3c772d79e153898ddd3177b71f77.gif

Cards

TheDead

Landscape Effect add “+10/20/40 Move Speed”

Bonds
COLORFUL (6)

Modified from “When equipping a card without enable its Type Bond, enable its first Type Bond.” To “When equipping a COLORFUL card without enable its Type Bond, enable its first Type Bond.”


Player Role
Killer

Monster Role
Marionette/Elder Marionette

Modified behavior mode, now the lead time for the first cast after appearing is greatly reduced

Vomiter/Elder Vomiter

Modified behavior mode, now it is more inclined to move towards the inhalation target

Theeye/Elder Theeye

Modified behavior mode, now it will rush after seeing the target

Brooder/High Brooder/Elder Brooder

Modified behavior mode, increased incubation frequency, fine-tuned incubation bomb explosion rate

Elder Ambusher

Contact damage increased from 15 to 30


Game Mechanics
PAGES

Now it is no longer necessary to pay the price to obtain the PAGES


Gameplay

Map

The location of the PAGE/SCRAP room will now be displayed directly on the map
Teleportation will be disabled when the BOOK is opened

UI
